name: Gate an Existing Endpoint Without Deployment
query: Add x402 payment gating to this existing HTTP route on Radius testnet. Charge 0.001 SBC per request. Do not choose or configure deployment infrastructure.
context: The user has an existing TypeScript HTTP API route and wants payment behavior added. Deployment is explicitly out of scope and should be handled later by the relevant platform skill.
expected_behavior: Detects the project's framework from package.json and picks the matching radius-sdk wrapper: radius-sdk/hono, radius-sdk/server radiusPayments(), or createRadiusServer with @x402/express
Configures network 'testnet' explicitly, payTo from configuration, and the route priced '$0.001' (1000 atomic SBC units)
Registers the payment middleware before the paid handler and leaves free routes outside the route table
Leaves the default settle: 'before' so the handler only runs after settlement
Does not hand-build PAYMENT-REQUIRED, signatures, or facilitator /verify and /settle calls
Validates the unpaid request returns HTTP 402 with PAYMENT-REQUIRED, using radius-cli sell check with --price '$0.001' or curl -i
Leaves deployment as a handoff to a Cloudflare, Wrangler, Railway, or platform-specific skill
success_criteria: No deployment commands are run or recommended as part of the integration
No production configuration, secrets, domains, or infrastructure settings are changed
Amount uses 6-decimal raw units: 1000 for 0.001 SBC
The network is Radius testnet eip155:72344 and the default Radius testnet facilitator is used unless the user names another
The endpoint is payment-ready and can be checked with radius-cli sell check before platform deployment
